How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
An elevated tee shirt
This tee shirt is a tighter more fitted dressed up version of a classic comfortable shirt. I am 5'4" and 136 pounds and a size medium fits snug without being uncomfortable. The shirt is stretchy. The stitching quality is perfect. The color of bright red is crisp and cheerful. The v neck is great because it isn't low cut but gives my neck plenty of room for being unrestricted. It is moderately breathable. It is a bit warmer than a loose fitting cotton shirt. I like that it can be styled to dress it up for work or also be crisp and fitted and comfortable for walks and casual attire. I bought the two pack of this shirt in a few colors and rotate them all especially in the spring and summer. I like them. They're slightly thicker than I expected but it gives them a more sophisticated look. They feel good and look more expensive than they were. After having it, machine washing and drying it for over six months, it still looks brand new with no loss of color or damage to the fabric. A good investment piece for looking elevated and still been comfortable and very easy to care for and wash. A good essential wardrobe item.
